choices.reason: The introduction singles out personalized versus generic AI for campaign creativity, and the Methods describes the partial-personalization condition as “a robustness test”. Both candidates use the same full-sample theme-diversity measure, so rule 2 favors full personalization over the robustness arm.
choices.locator: PDF p. 5, Introduction, second paragraph (quoted sentence); PDF p. 22, Experimental Design, first paragraph (partial personalization identified as a robustness test); PDF p. 10, Personalization as Pathway to Counteract AI-Based Homogenization (full-sample diversity summaries).
choices.quote: We find evidence of significant synergy, such that humans collaborating with personalized AI produce more creative campaigns compared to AI alone or participants who work with a generic tool.
